comment: MEM-005c failure matrix for the Create-hub sound/remix source pickers
acceptance test 5). Common-pure rows are pinned by unit batteries
MemeRemixHandoffTest on Android); adapter-lifecycle rows are the device
QA script (EDT-013). Nothing in this matrix may publish, sign or leave

cases.behavior: A relay delivering an event whose id differs from the pasted target never resolves the lookup; the picker keeps the paste field and names nothing published.
Open remix on a looping lineage is refused before the editor opens ('This lineage loops'); no draft, no seed. Re-checked pre-sign by the publish path.

cases.pinnedBy: device QA (EDT-013); store contract: RemixSourceLookup.State.Timeout / RemixSourceLookupStore.timedOut
cases.behavior: The named 'Checking this Bitz on relays…' stage settles to a timeout card with Retry; Cancel closes the sub and cancels the fetch. No project is created.

cases.pinnedBy: device QA (EDT-013); editor seeding contract (remix/sound LaunchedEffect)
cases.behavior: A URL that fails mid-download surfaces the editor's named failure ('Remix/Sound source could not be loaded'); the session stays usable, nothing signs.
A valid event with no loadable media offers 'Create credited post' (seeded composer); the tags retain remix/p/attribution and never claim a studio remix.

cases.pinnedBy: device QA (EDT-013); store contract: RecentBitzStore re-opens a fresh window per pubkey
cases.behavior: Switching accounts clears the picker's recent window and any in-flight lookup on close; the new account's list is scoped to its own pubkey. No cross-account seeds survive.
Malformed/oversized/unsupported/profile/address targets get the shared named rejection copy; the paste field and the hub stay intact.
